caseNameFull: Helvering, Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. F. & R. Lazarus & Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Jackson for petitioner, Messrs. Murray Seasongood and Robert P. Goldman for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
